id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_130.pack|cs_: "Nice, nice! Well done, {var:1}!
"I worried you couldn't learn Quadraslash so fast, but it seems I fretted for nothing.
{var:1} learned Quadraslash!
"That sword of light is the strength of your heart. Forge it into a sword that never breaks.
"Then you can face any hardship.
"Now, let's wake Robert...
"To defeat me after I learned the secret... I never thought you'd grown this much.
"{var:1}, you endured the hard training. From now on you're my fine disciple.
Found you...
"That voice... can't be!?
"Mordegon!!
You insects crawling in a dead world, I will destroy you here...
"No!
"Tch, Mordegon! His tentacles reach even the netherworld! I underestimated his power!
"Damn! There's still more I wanted to teach you!
"But it can't be helped! I'll give you the final secret here and now!
"The f-final secret!? Isn't Pearly Gates, which I learned, the temple's ultimate secret!?
"No! The combined move of Erdwin and Morcant is the true final secret devised by the first Grand Master!
"Ready, you two!? Cross the ages and repeat the legend!
"Let the final secret you cast be my parting gift to the afterlife!
I won't allow it!
"Strike on my signal! You have only one chance!
"Robert! Pour all your power into Pearly Gates and launch it to the sky!
"Nnnngaaaah!!
"{var:1}! Now, Quadraslash!
"This is the true final secret of Angri-La...
"Solar Flair!!
"They're back!
"Oh no! They're weakened! Quickly, carry them to the temple!
Exhausted, {var:1} lost consciousness and dreamed of Grand Master Pang using her last strength to blind Mordegon...
...And then, dawn broke!
"Good, you're awake. You seem fine too.
"Lord Robert woke earlier and is outside. Let's join him."
